cards.title: Framed Errand Office Scene
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper scene card for imagining one pretend window-frame view of an errand office detail: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, draw a simple pretend window frame at the top, and ask the writer to fill the first thing seen: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Look through the pretend frame and choose one office shelf, counter, or label that starts the scene: ____________________.
cards.sceneFrontPrompt: Front prompt: Through the pretend window frame, the Acorn Avenue Errand Office shows ____________________.
cards.sceneBackPrompt: Back prompt: Add one nearby object, one helper, and one label: ____________________.
cards.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A small errand waits on the sill marked ____________________.
cards.firstLinePath: First line path: From the window seat, I can see ____________________ beside ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one exact paper-scene detail inside the pretend frame: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch the frame first, then write one label: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Fold the card and start a new errand-office view with ____________________.

cards.title: Compass Shop Choice Scene
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper scene card for choosing what an imagined shop window view points toward: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, add a pencil dot inside the pretend frame, and have the writer choose the compass mark: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Pick one compass mark in the imagined window view and decide what changes on the shop shelf: ____________________.
cards.sceneFrontPrompt: Front prompt: In the pretend window view, the compass needle points toward ____________________.
cards.sceneBackPrompt: Back prompt: The shop helper must choose between ____________________ and ____________________.
cards.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A penny compass changes direction after someone writes ____________________ on a tag.
cards.firstLinePath: First line path: The compass in the framed shop view turns toward ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Make the choice clearer by naming one reason: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw two arrows quietly, then circle the one that points to ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Use the chosen arrow as the start of another paper scene: ____________________.

cards.title: Seed Library Helper Scene
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper scene card for inventing one map-room helper seen through a pretend frame: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, mark a small pretend window frame, and ask the writer to name the helper's job: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Imagine one Seed Library helper in the framed view and write what they carry on paper: ____________________.
cards.sceneFrontPrompt: Front prompt: Through the pretend frame, the Seed Library helper is holding ____________________.
cards.sceneBackPrompt: Back prompt: Character notes: name ____________________, careful job ____________________, map-room clue ____________________.
cards.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The helper notices a drawer card that says ____________________.
cards.firstLinePath: First line path: At the map-room table, ____________________ holds ____________________ like it matters.
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one action that shows what the helper wants next: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch the helper's hands first, then label what they hold: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Start another character scene with the helper carrying ____________________.

cards.title: Rain Gauge Railway Sequence Scene
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper scene card for ordering three imagined railway view moments on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, draw three small frame boxes, and invite the writer to fill the first box: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: In the imagined window view, write what happens first, next, and last at the rain-gauge railway: ____________________.
cards.sceneFrontPrompt: Front prompt: First the gauge line shows ____________________, next the railway sign shows ____________________.
cards.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The tiny railway changes its plan when the gauge marker reaches ____________________.
cards.firstLinePath: First line path: From the pretend window seat, first I notice ____________________, then I notice ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one transition word or small action between two steps: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Number the three boxes, then write the clearest step: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Save the three-step view for a new railway paragraph: ____________________.

cards.title: Moss Message Pattern Scene
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper scene card for turning a pretend observatory window view into a repeating pattern clue: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, invite the writer to draw a quiet framed view, and choose one repeating mark: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Design one moss-message pattern in the imagined window view and write what it might mean in the scene: ____________________.
cards.sceneFrontPrompt: Front prompt: The moss pattern in the pretend frame repeats like ____________________.
cards.sceneBackPrompt: Back prompt: Pattern notes: first mark ____________________, repeat mark ____________________, clue meaning ____________________.
cards.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The observatory helper copies the moss message onto paper and discovers ____________________.
cards.firstLinePath: First line path: In the observatory window view, ____________________ repeats beside ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one shape, line, or texture so the pattern is easier to follow: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the pattern silently, then name it with two words: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Use the pattern as the first clue in another paper scene: ____________________.
